TRPG, or Tabletop Role-Playing Game, is characterized by immersive role-playing where players embody their characters. Within the rules, players can steer the story in various open-ended directions, leading to different outcomes.

In a humble village untouched by ambition, ​Hua Jin lives an idyllic life as the adored daughter of a farming family—a rarity in an era where sons reign supreme. Content with her simple joys and doting kin, she dreams only of peace… until the skies turn vengeful.
But Hua Jin has a secret: a mystical space brimming with untold resources. While others scramble when droughts scorch crops, floods drown kingdoms, and plagues darken horizons, she smirks. “We’ve got this.”
Yet survival isn’t just about hoarding grain. With her family’s unwavering love as her shield, Hua Jin masterminds a laid-back revolution: turning their farm into a fortress, bartering wit for wealth, and outsmarting fate itself. Who needs panic when you’ve got a lazy genius with infinite storage and a clan that laughs in the face of doom?

treatise-of-a-failed-knight:
Has my life been for nothing?
I asked myself that question as I fell into the eternal embrace of death, having tumultuous waves of regret washing over me. But, in a strange twist of fate, I found myself awake once more in the body of my fifteen-year-old self.
What kind of sorcery is this?
The existence of the Leviathans and their mystical powers is all shrouded in mystery.
But none of it matters to me.
What matters now is that I can finally pursue the dreams and aspirations that I set aside in my past life. This time, I will ensure to live true to myself, without restraints or regrets.
I will be free.
Tags: Regression. Fantasy. Action. Adventure. SliceOfLife. Mystery. Time travel. NoHarem. WeaktoStrong. Antihero. Academy.
warm-marriage-ceos-unlimit-love:
Ning Jiang's father was a famous bridge designer but he was framed and the bridge he designed fell. He couldn't bear what happened and died soon. After his death, Ning Jiang's mother married another man who already had a daughter.
The new family treated Ning Jiang badly. Her stepsister, Mo Lan, even got involved in her relationship on purpose. As a result, her boyfriend betrayed her and Ni Jiang's heart was broken.
Meanwhile, Ning Jiang discovered that what happened to her father might be related to her stepfather or a man, Luo Hanshang, the fiance of her stepsister, who was in power of a huge business empire.
To find out the truth behind her father's case and even take revenge, she set up a trap for Luo Hanshang and attracted him successfully. She helped him solve a big case and won his trust. Then he married her as she planned. As time went by, he fell in love with her and even melted her heart, but she never gave up revealing the truth...
wedding-night-a-regretful-marriage-to-he:
Gu Qingcheng had a fiery temper and was well-known for being a spoiled brat in Jiangcheng. She even had a good boyfriend who pampered her beyond reason.
The only person who constantly went against her was her boyfriend’s uncle, Huo Sicheng. The two were known for being each other’s arch enemy.
However, during Gu Qingcheng’s engagement party, she publicly called off her wedding and announced that she would marry the crippled Huo Sicheng instead. All the guests were shocked by the announcement.
Just as everyone thought the couple would secretly argue all the time and guessed which of them would die first, the truth was…
“Honey, I came home late because the traffic was awful. Open the door and let me in.” Gu Qingcheng looked pitiful when she knocked on the bedroom door.
“Sleep in the living room,” Huo Sicheng said coldly.
“Honey, someone bullied me today.”
The next day, the person who bullied Gu Qingcheng disappeared into thin air.
“Honey, they all said I’m fierce.”
Huo Sicheng glanced at Gu Qingcheng. “That’s nonsense. You’re not fierce at all,” he said softly.
Ever since then, Huo Sicheng became Gu Qingcheng’s accomplice in all the bad deeds she carried out.…
